title: Consensus-based optimization with $α$-stable jump processes
summary: In this paper, we introduce a novel variant of the CBO method that incorporates jumps according to an $α$-stable stochastic process in a kinetic framework. This extension gives rise to nonlocal stochastic effects, which improve the exploration capabilities of the method. We formulate the method at the particle level, detailing the corresponding stochastic dynamics and its asymptotic behavior.
